# third-party/patches/

rnp source patches, applied by `scripts/build-rnp.sh`.

## Naming

`<NN>-<short-description>.patch` — `NN` is a two-digit sequence number
controlling apply order.

## Policy

- One patch per upstream issue.
- Each patch header MUST contain:
  - Upstream issue/PR URL
  - Author and date
  - Why the patch is needed locally
  - When it can be removed (e.g., "after rnp > 0.18.1 includes this fix")

## Current contents

Empty. The goal is to keep it that way.
